hooks.command: msg=$(jq -r '.tool_input.message // ""'); if printf '%s' "$msg" | grep -qiE '\b(close[sd]?|fix(e[sd])?|resolve[sd]?)[[:space:]]+#[0-9]'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Commit message contains a GitHub closing keyword directly before a PR number (the #202/#208 auto-close incident class). Reword: put the number first, or use a verb GitHub does not parse (finishes, completes, ends)."}}'; fi
